adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the `evt: CalendarEvent` literal passed to `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` does not set any `team` field (it only sets `organizer`, `attendees`, etc.). In `sendAddGuestsEmails` (`packages/emails/email-manager.ts`), the team-member notification loop is guarded by `if (calendarEvent.team?.members) { ... }`, so unless `formatCalEvent(calEvent)` can somehow synthesize `team` from the provided `calEvent` (not shown in the diff), that branch will never run and team members won’t receive notifications. This matches the finding: the loop is effectively dead given the event object constructed in the handler.
